text_en: Then Judith said to them, “Listen to me, my friends. Take this head and hang it upon the parapet of your wall.
text_cn: 友弟德对他们说：“兄弟们，请听我说：把这人头挂在城垛上。

text_en: As soon as day breaks and the sun rises on the earth, each of you take up your weapons, and let every able-bodied man go out of the town; set a captain over them, as if you were going down to the plain against the Assyrian outpost; only do not go down.
text_cn: 天亮，太阳上升照耀大地时，你们各拿武器，所有的壮丁，都应出城；并且立一个首领率领他们，仿佛要下到平原，攻击亚述人的前哨，但是不必下去。

text_en: Then they will seize their arms and go into the camp and rouse the officers of the Assyrian army. They will rush into the tent of Holofernes and will not find him. Then panic will come over them, and they will flee before you.
text_cn: 亚述人一见，必拿起武器，走到营里，叫醒亚述军队的官长，官长必跑进敖罗斐乃帐幕；若找不着他，必惊慌失措，从你们面前逃走。

text_en: Then you and all who live within the borders of Israel will pursue them and cut them down in their tracks.
text_cn: 此时，你们以及住在以色列全境内的人民，应去追赶他们，在他们溃退的路上，沿途截击。

text_en: But before you do all this, bring Achior the Ammonite to me so that he may see and recognize the man who despised the house of Israel and sent him to us as if to his death. ”
text_cn: 不过在作这事以前，请你们给我将阿孟人阿希约尔叫来，叫他看看，并辨认那轻视以色列家，打发他到我们这里来等死的人！”

text_en: So they summoned Achior from the house of Uzziah. When he came and saw the head of Holofernes in the hand of one of the men in the assembly of the people, he fell down on his face in a faint.
text_cn: 人就由敖齐雅家里将阿希约尔叫来。他一来到，看见会集的人群中，有人手提着敖罗斐乃的头，就立即晕倒在地。

text_en: When they raised him up he threw himself at Judith’s feet, and did obeisance to her, and said, “Blessed are you in every tent of Judah! In every nation those who hear your name will be alarmed.
text_cn: 人将他扶起，他就跪在友弟德脚前，叩拜她说：“在所有犹太帐幕里，在所有听到你名字而恐惧的万民中，你是应受赞美的！

text_en: Now tell me what you have done during these days. ” So Judith told him in the presence of the people all that she had done, from the day she left until the moment she began speaking to them.
text_cn: 如今请告诉我，你在这几天内做了什么！”友弟德就当着民众，把她从出城那天，直到现今与他们谈话时为止的所作所为，都一一告诉了他。

text_en: When she had finished, the people raised a great shout and made a joyful noise in their town.
text_cn: 她一说完，民众就大声呼喊，全城欢声雷动。

text_en: When Achior saw all that the God of Israel had done, he believed firmly in God. So he was circumcised, and joined the house of Israel, remaining so to this day.
text_cn: 阿希约尔看见以色列天主所作的这一切，就坚信了天主，受了割损，归依以色列家，直到今日。

text_en: As soon as it was dawn they hung the head of Holofernes on the wall. Then they all took their weapons, and they went out in companies to the mountain passes.
text_cn: 天一发亮，人们就将敖罗斐乃的头挂在城垛上，各人拿着武器，一队一队地，走向山坡的路。

text_en: When the Assyrians saw them they sent word to their commanders, who then went to the generals and the captains and to all their other officers.
text_cn: 亚述子民一看见，就打发人通知自己的头目；头目去见长官、千夫长和众将领。

text_en: They came to Holofernes’ tent and said to the steward in charge of all his personal affairs, “Wake up our lord, for the slaves have been so bold as to come down against us to give battle, to their utter destruction. ”
text_cn: 他们来到敖罗斐乃帐幕前，对总管说：“请叫醒我们的主上，因为那些奴才竟敢下来向我们挑战，他们要下来送死。”

text_en: So Bagoas went in and knocked at the entry of the tent, for he supposed that he was sleeping with Judith.
text_cn: 巴哥阿就进去，敲了帐幕的门帘，以为他还与友弟德同睡未起。

text_en: But when no one answered, he opened it and went into the bedchamber and found him sprawled on the floor dead, with his head missing.
text_cn: 但没有听到什么声音，就揭开门帘，走进寝室，发现敖罗斐乃横卧在脚凳上死了，头已被砍去，

text_en: He cried out with a loud voice and wept and groaned and shouted, and tore his clothes.
text_cn: 便大声呼喊、哭泣、呻吟、尖叫、撕裂了衣服，

text_en: Then he went to the tent where Judith had stayed, and when he did not find her, he rushed out to the people and shouted,
text_cn: 立即跑进友弟德住的帐幕里，也没有找着她，就跑到人们前喊说：

text_en: “The slaves have tricked us! One Hebrew woman has brought disgrace on the house of King Nebuchadnezzar. Look, Holofernes is lying on the ground, and his head is missing! ”
text_cn: “这些奴才造反了！一个希伯来女人给拿步高王朝带来了耻辱。看，敖罗斐乃死在地上，头不见了！”

text_en: When the leaders of the Assyrian army heard this, they tore their tunics and were greatly dismayed, and their loud cries and shouts rose up throughout the camp.
text_cn: 亚述军队的众官长一听这话，都撕裂了衣服，心慌意乱；此时营中哭声喊声混成一片。
